description: Page listSnapshots by cursor. The operation takes `cursor` and `limit` query parameters and answers { status, requestId, result: [...], limit, nextCursor } (the spec describes nextCursor as 'Cursor for the next page, to be sent as the `cursor` query parameter. Null on the last page.'). The converter's cursor detection does not recognise `nextCursor`, so the list was a single-page call. Not reachable on the test organization: GET .../snapshots answers 403 'early access API endpoint' (request id 58cc31cf-2c41-4233-aa7d-aefa3a49640e). The multi-page traversal was captured on listApiKeys, which answers the same envelope per the spec.
